direction: Definitions, mechanisms, development and current AI evidence
strategy: Inspect historical primary texts, psychology reviews and experiments, educational research, published AI creativity/selection work and dated 2026 evaluations. Follow author/institution-hosted copies when publisher access fails. Check version-specific metadata and limitations.
deliverable: 18 inspected source records and 23 bounded claims covering meanings, cognition, social context, development and AI.
questions_resolved: Taste has several distinct meanings rather than one universal trait.
Shared aesthetic preferences vary by domain; labels and social influence affect appraisal.
There is evidence for specific learning components, not a validated universal taste-training package.
AI can improve generation without improving selection, and learned evaluative preferences have narrow successes and failures.
next_direction: Separate skeptical audit of proposed narrative claims and outline.

direction: Independent skeptical audit and reader outline
strategy: Review the consequential assertions separately from evidence collection; compare claimed taste benefits with source designs, cultural and label effects, domain limits, proxy outcomes and version differences. Plan original comparisons that preserve a stated brief rather than pretending to prove universal aesthetic superiority.
deliverable: Skeptical audit and reader outline in review.md; bounded central argument and purposeful native visual plan.
questions_resolved: Popularity, universal standards, permanent human exclusivity and universal training conclusions are not established by the inspected evidence.
Generation quality and selection performance must be separated.
Practical examples and the programme will be labeled as original proposals.
next_direction: Author and render the page with complete exportable original figures.

direction: Author, refine and verify the canonical page
strategy: Write the evidence-informed narrative and three original native figures with one source of card text shared by HTML and Markdown. Add contextual disclosure notes, navigation and full-page export regression checks. Read the whole article, render four theme/width combinations and no-JavaScript baseline, fix concrete overview placement and mobile spacing/table issues, then repeat required validation and browser/export checks on the final version.
deliverable: Reviewed local taste page with 18 sources, three original figures, two native disclosure notes, six practice suggestions and a bounded practice experiment; new Human Capabilities navigation entry.
questions_resolved: The page distinguishes preference, appreciation, evaluative judgment and making decisions.
Original design and writing examples make judgment visible without implying measured winners.
All evidence limits and proposed-practice boundaries survive HTML and text exports.
Final native figures and tables remain readable on 320-pixel mobile screens and without JavaScript.
coverage_changes: All inquiry dimensions, evidence review and delivery checks complete.

direction: Generate and refine the opening infographic, preserving complete meaning
strategy: Reuse the inspected evidence; generate an original editorial illustration, then incorporate user feedback for more information and a cleaner design. Inspect all supplied image text, preserve originals and prompts, optimize the selected asset, reuse the existing image/export wrapper, keep the full native text equivalent and both comparisons, and verify the final shared build and rendered exports.
deliverable: Selected cleaner, information-rich generated Figure 1 with four teaching topics and a working loop; complete accessible/exported text, original comparison figures, saved prompts and provenance; final shared validation and four browser views passed.
questions_resolved: The opening can carry definition, AI relevance, concrete practice and context without repeated illustration panels.
All infographic information survives readable text and exports.
Both original comparisons and the substantive article are preserved; final shared-workspace checks pass.
coverage_changes: Evidence coverage unchanged; revised visual and all delivery gates complete.
